department: Department of Chemistry, Biochemistry and Physics

deadline.value: Priority deadline for fall admission is December 1; a secondary deadline is January 15.

notes: Biochemistry (Ph.D.) is run by the same department; its catalog page has the same admission text. The department typically does not admit for spring unless funded.
